name: StatusIndicator
purpose: Non-interactive 32px status cell holding a 20px glyph (A 19 folded up) that shows only while a status is active (reduced motion). Its explanation is a tooltip. Kept as its own widget (A) because it is a 32px cell with a conditional render and a tooltip, not an icon variant. B folds only the glyph into Icon xl.
base: Radix Tooltip (the reference used a title attribute).

props.name: icon
props.description: Glyph name, motion_photos_off in the reference. Rendered by Icon at xl.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Explanation shown on hover and on focus when the cell is focusable. Chooses between the Low Power wording and the Settings wording.

states: shown (only while the status is active)
keyboard: Not focusable in the reference. Recommend tabIndex 0 so the Radix Tooltip opens on focus and Esc closes it.
platform: Desktop only for the Low Power wording: 'Reduced motion active on Low Power Mode' is a macOS condition. Web cannot read Low Power Mode, so only the 'Reduced motion is on (Settings > General)' branch applies there, and that path names a desktop window, so web needs its own copy. Windows uses the OS reduced-motion setting.
open: 1) A hover-only tooltip is not reachable by keyboard or touch. Decide whether the cell is focusable (recommended tabIndex 0). 2) Whether web shows this indicator at all (it would come from prefers-reduced-motion) is a product decision. 3) The Settings > General wording needs a web version.
